title: Fixture: miss then hit
description: A first access *misses* and brings in the whole line, so `0x0A8` hits after `0x0A4`.

steps.text: The low 4 bits of an address are the `offset`, the next 3 the `index`, and the rest the `tag`.

steps.hint: Type `0x0A4` in the address box and press Issue.

steps.text: That load missed. Drag the timeline back to step 1.2, the *tag compare*.
Next you will load `0x0A8`. Will it hit or miss?
options: Hit: it is in the same 16-byte line as `0x0A4`
Miss: it is a different address
steps.explain: `0x0A8` has the tag and index of `0x0A4`; only the *offset* differs.
steps.hint: Compare the tag and index of `0x0A8` with those of `0x0A4`.

steps.text: A hit. Set 2 kept its valid bit, tag and data; only `r1` changed.
